user.title: Alice ↔ Arylic Sync
user.description: Pick the source (Yandex Station / Alice) and the output (Arylic in Music Assistant). All timing and volume settings can be changed later via Configure.

data_description.alice_entity: The media player where music starts and is voice-controlled.
data_description.arylic_entity: The Music Assistant player entity of your Arylic speaker (not the raw LinkPlay entity).

error.same_entity: Source and output must be different players.
error.music_assistant_missing: Music Assistant integration was not found. Install and configure Music Assistant first.

abort.already_configured: This Alice → Arylic pair is already configured.

init.title: Sync settings
init.description: Crossfade timing and volumes. The two knobs that matter most: 'Sync offset' (if Arylic plays behind Alice, increase it) and 'Arylic head-start' (if the volume jumps instead of stepping, increase it).

data.play_wait_timeout: Timeout: wait for Arylic to play (s)

data_description.sync_offset: Correction so Arylic plays the same second as Alice. Arylic behind → increase; Arylic ahead → decrease.
data_description.handoff_delay: Wait this long after music starts on Alice before handing off (0 = immediately).
data_description.steps: How many steps the crossfade takes. More = smoother but slower.
data_description.arylic_headstart_ms: Each step: how long Arylic leads before Alice steps down. Covers Arylic's command latency.
data_description.alice_gap_ms: Pause after Alice steps down before the next step.
data_description.arylic_floor: Arylic starts rising from this volume.
data_description.arylic_target: Arylic ends the crossfade at this volume.
data_description.alice_end_volume: Alice ends the crossfade at this volume (0 = silent; use 0.01 if your Station pauses at 0).
data_description.stop_fade_floor: When music stops, Arylic fades down to this volume before pausing.
data_description.alice_restore_volume: After the stop, Alice's volume is restored to this level.
data_description.stop_steps: How many steps the stop fade takes.
data_description.play_wait_timeout: How long to wait for Arylic to report 'playing' before continuing.
data_description.buffer_wait_timeout: How long to wait for the player to accept the new position after seeking.
data_description.track_uri_prefix: Prepended to Alice's media_content_id. 'yandex_music://track/' for Yandex Music; change for another Music Assistant provider.
